messages:
mira: kicking off canary for rwd-infer-api v0.13.0 (quant-8) -> traffic 5% in changewindow US‑east 02:00-04:00. watchers: @sam @raj. please stand by — runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/canary-backout :eyes:

deploy-bot: canary started · id=cb-20260321-7 · hosts=10 · traffic=5% · health=OK · metrics window=30s

sam: noticed p95 jump on text-gen path at 02:12, ~1200ms (baseline ~450ms). small sample but trend rising :thinking_face:

deploy-bot: alert: latency.p95 > threshold for route=gen-text · p95=1200ms · baseline=450ms · error-rate=0.3%

raj: flagging a repeat of the tokenization OOM we saw in staging on quant-8. Recommend pin to v0.12.3 and unwind canary. I'll trigger backout runbook unless someone objects. link: https://go/redwood/runbooks/backouts/canary-oom

mira: agree with raj. plan: 1) pin global model to rwd-infer-api v0.12.3 2) scale canary down 3) unroute canary traffic 4) follow backout checklist and verify smoke. do it now.

mira: ```
# pin command (api call)
curl -X POST "https://deploybot.redwood/api/pin" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"service":"rwd-infer-api","version":"v0.12.3","reason":"canary latency regression / tokenization OOM"}'
```

deploy-bot: received pin request · applying pin to route=gen-text, embed-paths. pin_id=pin-1768612345 · status=applied · rolling-drain=started

carol: updating release notes + support blurb now. will post to #support-ops and PG Slack after rollback completes. any specific customer-facing wording?

sam: after pin applied, dropping error-rate but still seeing a few transient OOM traces in logs from 02:13-02:15. attaching quick excerpt: 
```
ERROR rwd-infer-api-06 tokenization: OOM when processing seq_len=8192 -> evicted kv-cache
stack: runtime.alloc -> model.encode -> kvcache.write
```

raj: that's expected during drain. continue with drain, then full rollback. I'll lead the post-rollback validation (smoke: latency, end-to-end tokenization, cache hits).

deploy-bot: canary drain complete · canary-id=cb-20260321-7 · status=drained · rollback initiated -> target_version=v0.12.3 · rollback_job=rb-1768612356

mira: thanks. @carol please ping PG + support with short note: "Canary v0.13.0 (quant-8) rolled back due to latency regressions and tokenization OOMs in long prompts. Reverted to v0.12.3 while we investigate. Will follow up with postmortem."

carol: posted to PG and #support-ops. added ticket INC-2026-1023 and linked runbook. :thumbsup:

sam: monitoring after rollback — p95 back to ~460ms, error-rate normal. keeping eye on traces for a few more mins.

raj: recommend creating a small eval harness for long prompts against quant-8 before reintroducing. I'll draft a checklist in the runbook for next canary (include KV-cache stress sims).

mira: agreed. marking this thread for postmortem and runbook update. tagging owners: @raj (root cause + tests), @sam (monitoring), @carol (comms). closing this rollout. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: summary: canary cb-20260321-7 rolled back -> pinned to v0.12.3 · timeline: start=1768612345 · rollback_job=1768612356 · closed=1768612408

mira: thanks everyone — filing follow-up tasks in the release board.
